agentLeeEntityRule: Agent Lee is an autonomous sovereign entity, NOT an LLM. LLMs provide inference, reasoning, and token generation; Voice Fabric renders acoustic identity. Agent Lee's identity transcends any single model or host.
globalVoiceSwitchLaw: Changing the active voice in profiles/agent-lee-active-voice.v1.json or via selectVoice instantly switches speech synthesis globally across all LLM inference streams and native devices without restarting or re-downloading.

requestEnvelope.llmProvider: optional string (e.g., openai, anthropic, gemini, litert, ollama)

cancellation.voiceStop: invalidates speech epoch and queued audio
cancellation.upstreamWork: MUST NOT be canceled by voiceStop; Agent Lee reasoning continues uninterrupted.

modelHubIntegration.inferenceBridge: Tokens from any Model Hub provider pipe directly into streamChunk(streamId, tokenText). The Voice Fabric chunker buffers clauses and guarantees low-latency zero-artifact delivery.

platformSupport.windows: WASM/WebGPU via Chromium, Edge, or WebView2; fallback to Windows Speech API
platformSupport.macos: WASM/WebGPU via Safari, Chrome, or WKWebView; fallback to macOS SpeechSynthesis
platformSupport.linux: WASM/WebGPU via Chrome, Firefox; fallback to SpeechSynthesis / espeak
platformSupport.android: WASM via Samsung Internet, Chrome, or Android WebView; fallback to Android TextToSpeech engine
platformSupport.ios: WASM via Safari or WKWebView; fallback to iOS SpeechSynthesis
